newsitem.title: USA: Emerging debt prices better bid, rumors fly.
newsitem.headline: Emerging debt prices better bid, rumors fly.

text.p: Brady bonds were generally better bid in the New York trading session Tuesday with Brazil debt, in particular, outperforming others as rumors of a Brazil Brady buyback hit the market, traders said.
"It was generally a very upbeat market today and sentiment was very good across the board with everyone putting on their buying hats for a day at least," one Brady trader said.

Rumors in the marketplace that Brazil would issue a 10-year or 30-year global bond issue to use the proceeds to buyback Bradies, specifically discount and par bonds, gave the market a boost, traders said.
"The global bond rumors gave the market a pretty good bid tone...(Brazil) C's in particular rallied about 12 basis points today," one trader said.
At 1700 EST/2200 GMT, Brazil C bonds were quoted up 1/2 to 72-5/8 bid.
Brazil Disc Z debt gained 1/4 to trade at 75-3/4 bid.
Also supporting Brazil debt was the performance of the equity market, traders said.
"Brazil's equity market did extremely well today and was probably up almost 2.0 percent," one trader said.
Meanwhile, as expected the U.S. Federal Reserve opted to leeave interest rates steady at its last policy-making meeting of the year.
"The FOMC decision of "no change" was priced in...there was no relief rally at all," one trader said.
The decision left the key federal funds rate at 5.25 percent and the discount rate at 5.0 percent.
Among other key gainers, Venez Pars were up 1/4 at a 74 bid and Venez Flirbs gained an 1/8 to 87-1/8, traders said.
Argentine Pars were off 1/8 at 61-3/4 while Argentine Frbs gained 1/4 to 85-3/8 bid.
Russia's dollar Vnesh was unchanged at 77 bid, Min Fin 3 were up 1/8 at 83-5/8 bid.
